region_native.supports: Normal native ATC selection, registration and Update reproduce destructive cleanup in 44 baseline cases. controller_identity_native.supports: Native station collisions create cross-region duplicates; saved records retain both; local cleanup destroys the shared cargo hull while its market survives. Production reuse/load correction and native cargo delivery are verified offline. Ship/pilot construction, damage and Unity retirement services have explicit fixtures.

civilian_wait_native.supports: Actual native Hold/Main, Civilian FFWD and home dispatch, save reconstruction and unpatched-tree loading. delivery_native.supports: 521 native baseline/production checks include multi-actor stock, sizing, normal/SFF/refund handoffs, overflow disposal, save restoration, failure isolation and escape ownership. Crew materialization, physical placement and planner failure inputs are fixtures.

environment_conversion.supports: Native region conversion retains orphaned physical references; the legacy observer cancels a surviving identity; adapted conversion handling preserves direct/copied routes and respects authored removal. Asset creation, cleanup bookkeeping and presentation are explicit fixture boundaries.

attachment_checks.supports: Production DLL hooks execute with native Hold/Undock, retrieving-pilot HaulShip, saved-situation reconstruction and both SffAdvance adapters. Real ephemerides and group-following controls live in AttachmentPhysics.cs; full scene/economy, threat observations, angular steering and help-request state remain fixture boundaries. Conditional graph outcomes are not numerical forecasts.

attachment_collateral.supports: Independent production-DLL A/B tests execute actual SetThrust, current group-mass repair, native unbraced/braced wear, shutdown and saved-state release. Constructed native permanent identities reproduce the previous incomplete guard. They are not claims of a live station incident.
